_comment: Deployment channels every client can point at, and the contract each one is pinned to. THIS FILE IS THE CLIENTS HALF OF THE CASCADE GUARD: contractDigest is the tool surface the clients were generated against. scripts/generate.js compares it to the digest the deployed hub reports at /version, so a core change that has not reached the client configs fails a check instead of failing a tool call in someone editor. CD advances a channel pin only after that channel deploy has been smoke-tested. Shared by all clients: the pin describes the DEPLOYMENT, which is client-independent.

local.description: A hub on your own machine (npm run dev:hub). Plaintext is allowed here and nowhere else.

dev.description: Redeployed on every push to main, no gate. There is always something live and newer than the last release to point a client at.

prerelease.description: The App Service staging slot, deployed on a version tag and fully verified. What production is about to become.

production.description: The production slot. Its pin is only ever advanced by CD, after a slot swap has passed its post-swap smoke test.
